result.summary:
Only 8 of the 10–15 new halls I was asked for had enough official information to price. None fits the $32,139 envelope with the default assumed caterer ($60 food + $15 staff + $20 beer and wine + $3 soft drinks, 20% service: about $128–134 per guest all-in after tax). Most would fit with a caterer charging about $109–137 per guest all-in, depending on the venue.

Two fit "only with the trims" if the venue's rental is close to $0, and neither publishes a price:
- Beth El Hebrew Congregation ballroom (Alexandria): seats 290 with a dance floor; setup, breakdown and two police officers are included. A rental up to $511 still fits.
- Gray's Event Center (Woodbridge): up to 200 guests; tables, chairs and dance floor included. A rental up to $1,041 still fits.

The rest only work by spending the reserve, or are over:
- Greater Springfield VFD Community Hall (2024 price, music off at 11pm): $35,663 all-in, so the 10% reserve would be needed. It fits with a caterer at $113.88 per guest or less. Its public Google Calendar shows Sat 6, Sat 13 and Sat 20 Nov 2027 with no event listed and Fri 12 Nov busy. It is a single room with no separate cocktail space listed.
- McLean Community Center: $36,560 (caterer limit $109).
- Town of Vienna Community Center gym and Trinity Washington University (DC): about $35,200–35,300 even with $0 rental (caterer limit about $116).
- Columbus Club of Arlington: $35,450 with $0 rental.
- Lee Center Exhibit Hall (Alexandria): over, at $39,814.

Price, capacity with a dance floor, alcohol and second-room questions are still open for most of these; each candidate lists them.

Prior leads:
- Vienna VFD 2027 Saturday-evening price is $3,500 for 8 hours. Rounds add $400 and the kitchen $400. Its online booking currently runs only to 7 Nov 2027, so of the four dates only Sat 6 Nov is inside its window today.
- Sherwood Center takes bookings up to 2 years ahead, so all Nov 2027 dates can be booked now. Its FY2026 Saturday rate for the Full Performance Space is $3,000 for 5 hours plus $600 per extra hour.
- Leesburg Flame Room has published 2027 rates: $2,500 for a full Saturday (8am–midnight). It posts no catering or alcohol rules.
- Westfields posts no booking window; its pricing is only in a brochure I could not retrieve.

result.summary:
I re-opened the official pages for all 8 candidates and the 4 prior leads, and re-ran the model at 185 guests. None of the 8 is a confirmed fit. Two are dropped, and the scout's picture changes in four places.

1. **Town of Vienna Community Center: dropped.** Its July 2026 rental handbook says "Food and drink are not permitted in the gymnasiums" (both gyms). The only other large room, the Auditorium, holds 150 with tables. Rentals are also limited to the center's regular hours.
2. **Trinity Washington University (DC): dropped.** Its published rules for conferences and special events say guests "must not use alcohol" on campus. They also ban open flames and loud music (music exceptions only at the director's discretion). One line requiring extra security at events serving alcohol is the only hint otherwise. Even at a $0 rental the model gives $34,181, so it only works by spending the reserve.
3. **Columbus Club of Arlington: does publish prices.** The scout said it did not. Its November 2023 PDFs show in-house catering:
   - Silver wedding package $85/guest (2023): 5 hours of ballroom use, a 3-hour beer, wine and soft-drink bar, a bridal suite, linens, setup, staff, cake cutting and free parking.
   - Main Ballroom rental on top: $3,500 + 6% tax (2023). Extra hours are $500 each.
   - Outside caterers are allowed only if the ballroom rental rises to $8,000.
   - Model, with 2023 prices raised to 2027 (+17%), one extra hour and a rented dance floor: $32,967, which is $827 over the $32,139 limit, so it fits only with the reserve. If the ballroom floor can be used for dancing (no rental), it is $31,059 and fits with the trims. That makes it an edge case. Ceremony and cocktail rooms are unknown.
4. **Gray's Event Center (Woodbridge): corrected.**
   - The official site lists no dance floor (the scout counted one as included); it now costs $1,200 in the model.
   - Included: tables and chairs (25 five-foot rounds, 200 chairs), a private dressing room and free parking.
   - Tax is 9%, not 6%: Prince William County's meals tax has been 3% since 1 Jan 2026. I modeled 10% as the nearest conservative setting.
   - Its public booking calendar shows **Sat 20 Nov 2027 already BOOKED**; Sat 6, Fri 12 and Sat 13 Nov 2027 show as open.
   - Model at $0 rental: $31,555. The rental would have to be about $584–$808 or less. Price is unknown.

**Confirmed as the scout reported:**
- **Beth El Hebrew ballroom (Alexandria):** seats 290 with an 18×18 dance floor; setup and two police officers included; Saturday 6pm–midnight. Price is not published. It fits only if the rental is $511 or less. Fridays are not offered. A search snippet (lead only) suggests the rental form may be for members only.
- **Greater Springfield fire department hall:** $35,663, so reserve only. Its calendar shows every Friday evening busy (including 12 Nov 2027) and Sat 6, 13 and 20 Nov 2027 with no booking. There is no second room for cocktails.
- **McLean Community Center:** $36,560, reserve only. Its prices are dated May 2023 but are the current schedule (posted Sept 2026).
- **Lee Center (Alexandria):** $39,814, over even with the reserve.

**Prior leads (all confirmed):**
- **Vienna fire department hall:** $3,500 for a Saturday evening (2027), or $4,300 with round tables and the kitchen, for 8 hours; extra hours $100; everything ends by 11pm. There is also a $400 cleaning fee and a $200 on-site support fee. Online booking runs to 7 Nov 2027, so only Sat 6 Nov is open today. It is a single room.
- **Sherwood Center:** books up to 2 years ahead; FY2026 Saturday rates confirmed.
- **Leesburg Flame Room:** 2027 Saturday full day $2,500, plus $250 cleaning fee. Catering and alcohol rules are not published; the drive is about 50–60 minutes (ASSUMPTION), at the edge of the limit.
- **Westfields:** still no published prices or booking window.

result.summary:
I found only 2 new candidates, not the 10-15 asked for. Very few venues within 60 minutes of DC post wedding deals on their own sites. Those that do are mostly too small (Milton Ridge, VisArts, Cherry Hill Ballroom, The Venue at 112, Raspberry Falls), too expensive (Riggs Alumni Center, Sweeney Barn, St. Francis Hall, Kellogg, Bolger), or only discount January to March, not November. Hotels and Hyatt or IHG pages either publish no prices or block automated access.

The one real lead is Waterford Receptions: Springfield (Hazel Ballroom, 190 seated with dance floor) and Fair Oaks (Alexander/Carrington, 300). Its packages are all-inclusive:
- **Emerald Buffet, $77/person + 22% service + tax:** cocktail room for one hour, ballroom for four hours, beer/wine/soda open bar, linens, dance floor, free parking, and a free hotel night.
- **Ceremony:** on-site at $6/person.
- **Deal:** the "Savings Calendar" takes 10% to 25% off certain dates, but only with Waterford catering.

Budget model at 185 guests:
- **Without the deal:** $23,636 if the prices are treated as 2026, or $30,282 if treated as 2019 prices. Both are "FITS only with the trims".
- **With a discount on the 2026 basis:** 10% off gives $21,648 and 25% off gives $18,666. Both are "FITS as-is".
- **Highest package that still fits:** about $114/guest before service and tax, in 2027 dollars.

Big caveats:
- **The website may be dead.** The waterfordreceptions.com home page now shows gambling spam. The package pages look like an old copy, and the savings calendar stops in 2018. Prices are undated and probably from 2018-2019.
- **Deal dates unknown.** No 2027 discount dates are published, so it is unknown whether Sat 13, Sat 6, Sat 20 or Fri 12 Nov 2027 get a discount. My assumption: November Saturdays are full price and Fri 12 is the best bet.
- **Not confirmed:** the end time (packages are 5 hours), whether outside DJs and florists are allowed, and the ceremony room at Fair Oaks.

Peerspace was not checked (it can't be opened), and no Peerspace listing showed up in searches.

Before relying on Waterford, the couple should call to confirm it is still operating and ask for 2027 prices and the November 2027 discount dates in writing (Springfield 703-719-5700, Fair Oaks 703-352-3200).

Riggs (November off-peak $8,500 Fri/Sat, $8,000 Sun-Thu) and Sweeney Barn were priced and are over budget by $3.9k to $6k even with the trims and the reserve.

I found 8 new candidates in scope and priced each with the budget model at 185 guests. The target is $32,139, the trimmed envelope.

Three are fits, and every fit still has open must-have questions:
- **Great Room at Historic Savage Mill.** $29,883, FITS only with the trims. All figures are published: the 2026 Saturday-evening room rate of $2,995 plus Putting on the Ritz (POTR) 2026 menus. Its ceremony and cocktail space is a tented deck, so an indoor heated ceremony and cocktail space must be confirmed or it fails.
- **Morningside Inn.** $29,616, FITS only with the trims. Its in-house catering is required and unpriced, so the fit holds only if catering is at most $142.5 per guest all-in. Its distance from DC is borderline.
- **The Gathering Place, Clarksville.** It publishes no rental price, so the verdict is conditional: it fits with trims if the rental is at most about $2,000 with the assumed caterer, or about $6,000 with POTR's published menu. It has the best room setup of the eight: a 265-seat ballroom, a partition ceremony and a separate cocktail room.

Cascades Overlook needs the 10% reserve on Saturday 13 Nov. It FITS only with the trims on the Friday 12 Nov backup paired with a caterer at about $109 per guest, such as POTR's published pricing.

The other four need a quote or don't fit as priced:

result.summary:
Neither Waterford lead holds up as a ready-to-use deal. I refuted neither, since both are within 60 minutes and the capacities check out, but both are marked unclear.

Corrections to the scout:
1. **Price year is likely 2018, not 2019.** The savings calendar's current month is October 2018, with links to Sep and Nov 2018, so the package text was most likely captured around Oct 2018. At $77 per person on that basis, Emerald without a deal comes to $31,389 at 185 guests, not $30,282. That fits only with the trims, with $750 headroom, so it is edge, not fits. On the 2026 basis it is $23,636 (fits with the trims).
2. **The deal is not real for November 2027.** The calendar only covers Sep-Nov 2018, and in the displayed October 2018 every day is regular price. The 10-25% colors appear only in the legend. Nothing is published for any November 2027 date, so the Fri 12 Nov discount guess has no support.
3. **The business presence has changed.** waterfordreceptions.com is a spam-hijacked static mirror (Last-Modified Apr 2025). The Springfield address now has its own site, Waterford Event Center (waterfordeventcenter.com, 703-850-7282, Wix ©2022). It publishes no prices, capacities or policies. No current page exists for Fair Oaks, so its operating status is unknown and its fit is 'unknown'.
4. **Tax.** 10% is correct: Fairfax County's 4% meals tax runs from 1 Jan 2026. The county FAQ says the 4% does not apply to separately stated service charges, so the model overstates by about $180.

Confirmed:
- Hazel Ballroom seats 190 with dance floor, cake and DJ table (only 5 spare at 185). Alexander/Carrington seats 300 with a 180 minimum; Alexander alone is 180, too small.
- Ceremony is $6 per person, indoors (no outdoor area). Springfield's ceremony rooms hold 200 each; Fair Oaks publishes no ceremony room.
- Emerald includes the cocktail room for one hour. Catering and bar are in-house; BYO cake is allowed.
- Deposit $1,200, 35% due at 90 days. Earliest evening start is 4:00 pm Springfield and 5:30 pm Fair Oaks, so a 10 pm+ end works.
- Drive: Springfield 13.4 mi (~20 min free-flow), Fair Oaks 21 mi (~33 min).

Break-even: a written 2027 quote of at most $110.48 per person before the 22% service charge and 10% tax gives at least $1,000 headroom. At most $114.51 still fits the trimmed envelope; at most $77.98 fits as-is. Sapphire's full bar on the 2018 basis needs the reserve ($34,569).

Peerspace was not opened. No Waterford listing appeared in a Peerspace-only search.
